details.question: 狮城银行支持哪些卡组织？
details.answer_preview:
狮城银行借记卡支持 Visa，信用卡支持 Mastercard，另提供银联借记卡。所有卡片均支持 Apple Pay 和 Google Pay。

details.question: 外币兑换和海外刷卡会收取哪些费用？
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.answer_preview:
在多币种账户内兑换货币不另收手续费，成本已包含在买卖汇率差价中。用 Visa 或 Mastercard 卡进行外币消费（含海外网站外币付款）收取交易金额 3.25% 的外币交易费，银联卡为 1%。以新元付款的海外商户可能自行收取动态货币转换（DCC）费用，建议选择以当地货币付款。

来源：《费用与汇率》外币兑换与外币刷卡费用；《费用与汇率》ATM 取款费用；《费用与汇率》海外电汇（TT）手续费

details.question: 银行卡到期前会自动续发吗？
details.answer_preview:
会，卡片到期前一个月，我们会自动把新卡寄到您登记的地址，卡号不变，有效期和安全码会更新。收到新卡后请及时激活，并在使用自动扣款的商户中更新有效期和安全码。

来源：《银行卡服务》卡片即将到期；《银行卡服务》订阅扣款在换卡后失败

details.question: What is the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.answer_preview:
PayNow sends to a mobile number, NRIC or UEN and arrives instantly, 24/7. FAST sends to any Singapore bank account by account number, usually arrives within minutes, and supports up to SGD 200,000 per transfer.

Source: Transfer and receiving guide – Ways to transfer money

details.question: What are the fees for withdrawing cash overseas?
details.answer_preview:
For overseas ATM withdrawals, Lion City Bank charges SGD 5 per withdrawal plus a 3.25% foreign transaction fee. The overseas ATM operator may also add its own fee, which will be shown on the screen.

Source: Fees and exchange rates – ATM withdrawal fees; Fees and exchange rates – Unfamiliar charges on your statement

details.question: Which card networks does Lion City Bank support?
details.answer_preview:
Lion City Bank supports Visa through its debit card and Mastercard through its credit card. It also offers a UnionPay debit card for spending in mainland China. All cards work with Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Source: Card services – Card networks and where cards are accepted

details.question: How long does an overseas TT usually take?
details.answer_preview:
Arrival time for Overseas TT: Submitted before 3 pm on a business day: processed same day, usually 1–3 working days, up to 5 for some countries

Source: product data (knowledge graph)

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 周末会不会调整？
details.answer_preview:
周末和公众假期会使用锁定牌价，并加收 0.5% 的波动缓冲，不像工作日那样约每 5 分钟更新。实时牌价可以在 App 的“汇率”页面查看。

来源：《费用与汇率》汇率如何确定

details.question: 海外 ATM 取款的 standard fee 是多少？
details.answer_preview:
海外 ATM 取款每次收取 SGD 5，若涉及外币金额，另加 3.25% 外币交易费。海外 ATM 运营商也可能另外收费，具体会在屏幕上显示。

来源：《费用与汇率》ATM 取款费用；《费用与汇率》账单上看不懂的费用；《费用与汇率》海外电汇（TT）手续费

details.question: 海外刷卡的 foreign currency fee 怎么算？
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.answer_preview:
海外刷卡的外币交易费按交易金额计算：Visa 或 Mastercard 卡为 3.25%，银联卡为 1%。若海外商户提供动态货币转换（DCC），可能另收费用，建议选择以当地货币付款。

来源：《费用与汇率》外币兑换与外币刷卡费用；《费用与汇率》海外电汇（TT）手续费；《费用与汇率》ATM 取款费用
